warnings: Pile caps on I-0.15 x 0.15 m piles 6.00 m long: F1 6 piles, F2 12 piles; safe load per pile not printed.
Neither cap is square, so depth_mm carries the second plan side (section 6b). main_bar.count is the two-way total; the direction split is kept in bars_by_direction.
Cap thickness F1 0.30 / F2 0.35; the 0.05 + 0.05 below are lean concrete and sand (own fields). 1.00 from ระดับดินเดิม down to the top of the cap.
Rebar grade is printed only as DB12 (no SD grade on this sheet); the A-01 notes say footing-column-beam steel is SR24 — see the notes file warning.
